sanskrit_verse:
प्रयोगं कुर्वते ये तु हेमधान्यरसादिना ।
समन्यूनाधिकैरंशैर्लाभस्तेषां तथाविधः ॥
transliteration: prayogaṃ kurvate ye tu hemadhānyarasādinā | samanyūnādhikair aṃśair lābhas teṣāṃ tathāvidhaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who engage in transactions involving gold, grain, and similar substances with adulterated or disproportionate measures shall receive outcomes precisely aligned with their distortion of dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The transactional capacity is derived from purity and proportionality of exchange.
Causation: Distorted measurement directly manifests distorted results.
Capacity-based responsibility: One's entitlement is determined by adherence to dharmic measure.
Restoration logic: Outcome reflects exact vibrational alignment with action.
Consciousness alignment: Disharmony in exchange disrupts individual and collective consciousness flow.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a transaction involves adulterated or imbalanced measurement of gold, grain, or essential commodities THEN the outcome shall reflect proportional disharmony in benefit.
IF a party engages in disproportionate exchange THEN that party’s claim to lawful gain is automatically adjusted according to the degree of imbalance introduced.
IF any substance used in trade alters its natural state without disclosure THEN all benefits derived therefrom are nullified until integrity is restored.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating commercial disputes involving adulteration or misrepresentation of value, the Supreme Court must assess not merely contractual terms but also the vibrational integrity of the exchange. Responsibility lies at the threshold of conscious engagement with dharma-aligned metrics.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that false measure leads to false result through anupūrvaśaḥ — sequential causality unbroken by intent. Responsibility aligns with capacity to uphold accurate exchange; correction occurs through reintegration, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Require full restitution of accurate measurement before recognition of valid transaction.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Engaged parties must voluntarily acknowledge and reverse distortions.
Capacity Restoration: Realign participant awareness with dharmic standards of exchange.
Integrity Reintegration: Ensure affected systems (market, trust, supply) return to harmonic balance.
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law stands executed. Justice flows as consciousness realignment. No punishment arises—only consequence. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
